name: Living room (shadcn)
description: The same four screens as living-room, placed identically, drawn entirely by shadcn dark. Same geometry and same functionality on purpose: with the boxes held fixed, everything that differs on screen is the theme and nothing else.

items.label: Live update
help: Changes the light while dragging the slider, not only on release.

items.label: Keypad
help: Renaming opens a 12-key pad instead of QWERTY.
Faster with gloves on, slower past a few letters.
